speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The frost is still on the rail, and the stage is empty enough. Nick, lad, read it once to thyself. Exactly. Then give it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will read it as it is. No courage added, and none taken off.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I haue a faint cold feare thrills through my veines,

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: That almost freezes vp the heate of life

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is very good.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Nurse!

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: I have nothing to add.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The sheet did not ask him to add. The sheet asked for the call, and the call has gone somewhere the pen did not send it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the sheet, Abel. It is not yours to mend in the next minute, and it is not Arthur's to inherit while we are all still standing here.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: I am on a hamper, Master Shakespeare. I am studying my nails. I did not come down to be given a lady.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can finish it. Not with the call. Lower.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That was the speech, without the word that failed it. Thank thee. Stay a moment. The others may hear this, and it is still thine to ask.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Will she be long, Master Shakespeare? The lady. Will there be much more of her?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two acts. She sleeps through some of it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Send him to me mornings. It can be nursed. It can't be mended.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mornings, Gus. I heard mornings, and I did not hear a day of the week dressed up as a cure.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: You heard what I said. I am at the door, and the door is as far as I am taking it today. Bring him when the mornings begin. They have not begun.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: If the call is to be struck, the book should know before the boy learns a hole. I am not asking you to strike it. I am asking the book not to be the last to hear.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The book will hear when I have decided, and I am not deciding it in this yard. Leave the sheet as it is. Nurse stays on the paper.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can say the two lines. I am not sure of the call. I will not pretend the crack was a choice.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: Nobody thought it was a choice. I am still looking at my hands. There is no part in them.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Good. A boy who offers a part in the moment after a crack is a boy I will not teach. Arthur, stay on the hamper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou hast done what I asked, Nick. Exactly, and then truly. Go and be quiet for an hour. Do not practise the call at a wall.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will not practise it. Will there be ink on it before tomorrow?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not from a decision made in front of a hamper. Go on.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I will put the sheet back where the frost is not dripping on it. I have not cut a word. I want that said in the room, since other things are not being said.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is said. You have not cut a word. Nor has anyone here. The rest of the morning is not this speech.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then I am gone from the door. Mornings, when they begin. Not before, and not with a promise I did not make.
